newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS' LONGLEY HURT IN SWIMMING ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS' LONGLEY HURT IN SWIMMING ACCIDENT.

text.p: Australian Luc Longley, the starting centre on the NBA champion Chicago Bulls, is out for an indefinite period after suffering a separated left shoulder in a swimming accident Sunday night, the team said Monday.

The 7-foot-2 (2.18 metres) Longley was injured while the Bulls were in Los Angeles to play the Clippers Monday night. The 27-year-old centre returned to Chicago where he was to be examined by team doctors Tuesday.
Longley, a six-year NBA veteran, is averaging 7.3 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.3 blocks in 21.4 minutes per game in his third season with Chicago.
Longley, a first-round draft pick of the Minnesota Timberwolves in 1991, was dealt to the Bulls in 1994 for centre-forward Stacey King.
